set.notes: D23 states that Doctor Strange and America Chavez accidentally teleport to Earth-838 and are treated there as visitors from another universe. Doctor Strange and America Chavez are represented as confirmed travelers; no additional universe identity is inferred for America.

Doctor Strange's Earth-838 arrival is depicted in the main story of Multiverse of Madness; America Chavez is also present and is represented as a canonical traveler participant in the same depicted occurrence.

D23 explicitly names Doctor Strange as one of the people teleported to Earth-838 and identifies the source-side individual as 616 Steven Strange. America Chavez is represented by a separate canonical traveler participant in the same event.
